facts.value: German is the teaching language of most degree programmes; English-taught international programmes usually need only English proof. German makes daily life and social life much easier.
facts.notes: Germany-wide DAAD guidance, not city-specific; exchange stays of 1-2 semesters may be exempt from German proof.

facts.value: Germany-wide (DAAD): waiting tables, shops, offices, tutoring, trade fairs, industry, university student-assistant jobs. Big cities like Munich usually pay more but cost more.
facts.notes: No city-specific student job-market data found; DAAD national guidance. Non-EU students: 140 full / 280 half days per year (student-assistant jobs exempt); EU/EEA/Swiss: unrestricted.

facts.value: Min. €13.90/h gross (statutory, 2026; €14.60 from 2027). University student assistants (SHK): €15.20/h from summer semester 2026 (TdL guideline)
